nodes.question: What types of habitats are included in the Tropical Moist Forest of EBG according to Holdridge (1967)?
nodes.answer: The Tropical Moist Forest of EBG includes primary forest, secondary forest, saw-grass swamp, and thorn scrub.
nodes.paragraph: 1). The Tropical Moist Forest (Holdridge 1967) of EBG consists of several habitat types including both primary and secondary forest, saw- grass swamp and thorn scrub. It is bordered to the east by concessional agricultural lands that belong to the nearby Q eqchi Maya community of Paso Caballos. The work extends on Griffin (2022 unpublished thesis) and Griffin et al. (2023). Field methods Sampling was conducted in one disturbed edge habitat (named disturbed habitat and assigned the code MH1), two primary forest habitats (named forest habitat with the code MH2), and one secondary habitat with natural edge (named edge habitat with the code MH3) (Fig. 2). Surveys in dis- turbed habitat (MH1) were conducted at the eastern border Oecologia (2025) 207:52 52 with the concessional agricultural lands of the Paso Caballos approximately 2 km east of EBG.
